title: Paired Bluetooth devices
whyItMatters: BlueZ keeps one folder per paired device with its name, MAC address and pairing keys. The names alone show which phone, headset, car or keyboard the person paired, and the keys allow reconnecting to those devices.
source: BlueZ settings storage docs: adapter and remote device data is kept under /var/lib/bluetooth, one folder per adapter address and per device: https://bluez.readthedocs.io/en/latest/settings-storage/
notes: The folder is root-only, hence requiresElevation; the rule reports the folder and its timestamp, not the device folders inside. Older BlueZ 4 installs used a single linkkeys file in the same tree. Systems without Bluetooth never create the folder.

steps: Open Settings > Bluetooth from your desktop application menu.
Select each paired device in turn and click Forget Device or Remove Device.
cleanup.risk: Removes pairings for all Bluetooth devices. You will need to pair headphones, keyboards, and mice again.
cleanup.source: GNOME Help, Connect your computer to a Bluetooth device: https://help.gnome.org/users/gnome-help/stable/bluetooth-connect-device.html
